datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SOD-123 Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: Family datasheet MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B; MMSZ5254B row (type code K4): VZ min/nom/max = 25.65/27.0/28.35 V at IZT = 5.0 mA; ZZT = 600 ohm; IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 21 V (p. 3).

The p. 3 table header specifies the zener impedance condition as ZZT at IZT = 0.25 mA for these rows, while VZ itself is specified at IZT = 5.0 mA; ZZT = 600 ohm at 0.25 mA has no schema slot and is recorded here verbatim.
Maximum ratings (never fitted): PD = 500 mW, Tj = -55 to +150 degC, RthJA = 340 degC/W (p. 1).
Full manufacturer name on the datasheet: Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd (www.ichjc.com).

Fig.2 (p. 3) contains 17 labeled curves (11...39 V); the 12th path from the left, matching the '27' label position and ordering, was digitized from the PDF vector path. Axes calibrated against tick labels; x linear 10-45 V, y log 0.5-100 mA. The plotted 27 V curve spans 0.5 mA at 26.12 V to its 12.9 mA endpoint at 27.56 V (it terminates at the 500 mW power envelope).
Curve y-values converted from the plotted mA axis to A.

No per-part capacitance value exists; Fig.5 (p. 4) gives family-level typical capacitance vs nominal zener voltage at 0 V / 1 V / 50% VZ bias and was not digitized because it is not a per-part specification; capacitance is null.

Fig.3 (temperature coefficients), Fig.4 (typical leakage vs nominal VZ), Fig.6 (impedance vs nominal VZ) and Fig.7 (power derating) are family-level charts against nominal zener voltage and were not digitized.

source_kind 'typical' on specified test currents (IF, IZT) means 'exact specified test condition'; source_kind 'typical' on VZ nominal marks the nominal column, with min/max recorded in the conditions string.
All values converted to SI base units (uA -> A, mA -> A).
